Let D1 [⃗ α] = D2 [M α ⃗ + ⃗c] for some integer matrix M and constants ⃗c. Then D1 [⃗ α] = (D2′ ◦ E)[⃗ α] where E is constructed out of Z-spiders with phases from ⃗c and fan-out X-spiders. Proof. Do the same construction as in Lemma 5.9 iteratively where we fix every parameter except one, to extract it into E and set β = 0 in all cases. This does not imply that non-parsimonious reductions can always be reduced to a parsimonious one with the same parameter count.
